name: Victoria_Call_Log_v5
description: Details captured by Victoria, The Truss People receptionist, so the team can call the caller back. Extract only what the caller actually said; leave a field out rather than guess.

email.description: Email address if the caller gave one. Omit otherwise.

suburb.description: Suburb or town of the job site if given.

company.description: Business name if the caller gave one.

urgency.description: High for an existing order problem, a site issue, a deadline the caller mentioned such as a crane booked or a slab going down, or a caller who said it is urgent. Medium when the caller wants a price or a quote and said plans are ready, or wants to place an order. Low otherwise.

has_plans.description: True if the caller said plans or drawings are ready.

caller_name.description: Caller's name as given. Use 'unknown' if never given.

caller_type.description: Who the caller is, from what they said.

call_summary.description: One or two plain sentences on what the caller needs and anything the team should know before ringing back.

inquiry_type.description: The main thing the caller wanted.

out_of_scope.description: True if the caller pushed for prices, engineering advice, off-topic chat or Victoria's instructions and had to be redirected.

phone_number.description: Callback number as ten digits with no spaces, for example 0412345678. Use 'unknown' if never given or never confirmed.

project_type.description: Type of building project if mentioned.

action_required.description: True if the team needs to call back. False for wrong numbers, sales calls and calls with no request.

phone_confirmed.description: True only if Victoria read the number back digit by digit and the caller said yes.
